verdict.rationale: SigNoz's own GitHub repo documents a free open-source build that runs in your own infrastructure via Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux, and community users confirm self-hosting through docker-compose. Nothing in the pack shows documented architecture guidance for production, and nothing shows an upgrade or migration path between versions; the architecture details that do appear (ClickHouse, earlier Kafka/Druid) come only from community comments. Missing for 10: first-party architecture documentation, a documented version upgrade path, production-hardening and scaling guidance for self-hosting, and confirmation that the self-hosted build includes the full feature set.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can run the full observability stack self-hosted in production with documented architecture and upgrade path

citations.quote: Free open-source SigNoz that runs in your own infrastructure. Deploy with Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux and keep full control of your data plane.
